testing.layout_hint: Draw a test pyramid with three layers: unit (domain, usecases, app sync components) at the base using Vitest, integration (infrastructure/github ACL) in the middle using Vitest+MSW, and E2E (async Server Components, accessibility) at the top using Playwright and axe. Beside the pyramid, add a small two-loop TDD diagram: an outer loop labelled 'E2E Red -> Green (SD-1/SD-2)' wrapping an inner loop labelled 'unit Red -> Green -> Refactor'. Use small tool icons or labels (Vitest, RTL, MSW, Playwright, axe) next to their layer.

cloudflare.layout_hint: a left-to-right request-flow diagram: browser -> Workers Static Assets / Workers Caching -> Worker (OpenNext adapter) -> GitHub API / GitHub OAuth, with a Rate Limiting binding attached to the Worker. Below the Worker box, stack three cache layers labelled L1 (in-request memoization), L2 (InMemoryCache, the main layer), and L3 (external store, not adopted). Add a small side lane showing three environment boxes: local, preview (versions + alias), production, with arrows indicating wrangler deploy paths.
